Companion Animal Travel Desk: Preparing for pet travel

Aurelia Skyways keeps pet travel simple when you bring the right papers, the right carrier, and a calm plan. Start by checking that your animal is fit to travel and that any required health records are current. Keep the carrier secure, labeled, and easy to carry, and make sure the pet can stand, turn, and lie down without strain.

Before you arrive, review the route guidance sent by the airline and pack what your pet may need for the trip. Food, water, absorbent liners, and a familiar cloth can help reduce stress. If you are traveling with more than one animal, separate them if the travel desk has advised it, and keep each carrier closed until staff ask you to open it. Samuel Ali should be ready to follow staff direction during check-in. <<FACT F012>> Keep the pet calm, and let the staff handle any routing or holding instructions.

If your trip includes a brief stop for review, stay with the animal and avoid changing labels or paperwork unless a staff member asks you to. Eva Kim should keep documents close and easy to show. <<FACT F028>> The quarantine room process is handled by the senior coordinator, who checks the paperwork, confirms the carrier condition, and gives clear next steps. If staff need to pause the handover, they will explain what happens next and keep the review calm and orderly.

For arrival, carry the pet out only when a staff member says it is safe. Check the carrier for any damage, confirm that your belongings are complete, and ask for help right away if the pet seems unsettled or unwell. Ruby should remain secured until you are told otherwise. The team will keep the process steady and will pass along any follow-up guidance without delay.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support before you travel.
